milestone: H2-v2 M2g — unexplained source-transition semantics diagnosis

interpretation.conclusion: The preregistered M2g trade-semantics tests account completely for only 1 of the 124 frozen M2f unexplained source transitions. No same-token last_trade_price event was found inside the server-time interval while arriving outside the ingest interval, so the frozen out-of-ingest-order same-token hypothesis received no support. Same-market different-token trade candidates were present in 110 pairs, but only 2 of 184 mismatch levels had the required complementary price alignment and only 1 level was also size-covered. Therefore the presence of complementary-token trade events is generally temporal coincidence rather than sufficient accounting for the observed quantity reductions under the frozen rules.
interpretation.replay_implication: The remaining replay divergence cannot be repaired by simply incorporating same-token out-of-order last_trade_price events or complementary-token last_trade_price events under the preregistered deterministic accounting rules.
interpretation.source_semantics_implication: A substantial set of ws_book quantity reductions or level removals remains unaccounted for by the captured price_change and tested last_trade_price semantics.

next_milestone: New engineering milestone required before changing replay semantics or acceptance criteria.
